title: Phasmalian Cliffside City
description: A detailed isometric fantasy city built on a rocky mountainside features blue-domed towers and a spiraling central keep connected by massive blue aqueducts carrying flowing water. Below, a medieval town square with a fountain is surrounded by half-timbered buildings with red roofs, while small figures populate the winding streets and bridges.
prompt: Isometric view of a detailed fantasy city built into a steep rocky mountainside, featuring a prominent spiraling citadel with multiple blue onion domes at the top, connected by long elevated blue aqueducts carrying water through the town. Below are dense clusters of medieval half-timbered houses with reddish-brown roofs, a central town square with a fountain, and tiny human figures walking the cobblestone streets. Whimsical storybook style with clear daylight, visible compass rose in the sky.
